race.comment: We see another clash between CINNAMON KISS (4) and EMPRESS ROSSA (6). CINNAMON KISS easily accounted for Empress Rosa (by 2.8 lengths) at Hamilton when they clashed two back at similar prices. Since then, both have won again, CINNAMON KISS easily here in a BM62, EMPRESS ROSSA by 5 lengths in a maiden. The lean has to go to CINNAMON KISS again with Meech opting to stick with her over EMPRESS ROSSA. FAST 'N' INZAINE (9) presents third up. Two runs this time in on synthetic have been sound, wet ground is an unknown but she can run well. ARTISTIC GENIUS (3) has been thereabouts this time in and has each-way claims from IMMINENT STORM (10) who could surprise fresh.
